# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities in public issues or discussions. Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting:

- [Report a Bridge vulnerability](https://github.com/mealie-atelier/mealie-atelier-bridge/security/advisories/new)

Private reporting is enabled on this repository. Include the affected version, a concise impact description, and steps to reproduce when safe. Do not include household recipe data, access tokens, or other personal information. Avoid testing against another person's installation.

## Supported versions

Security fixes go into the latest release of Mealie Atelier Bridge. Please update to it before reporting.
